summary.title: A2Q2 Protecting the Financial Core
summary.description: This system protects sensitive customer PII stored in the database using Application-Level Encryption (ALE) and centralized Key Management. The application encrypts sensitive fields before writing to the database, ensuring DBAs, cloud admins, or attackers with storage-level access only see ciphertext. A Key Management Service (KMS) securely stores and protects encryption keys using envelope encryption. The system also uses TLS to protect data-in-transit and Active-Active multi-region replication
